title.zh: 将南三宝颜省Mahayag市镇Daniel C. Mantos描笼涯的San Jose国立中学附属校分离出来，单独改设为独立的Daniel C. Mantos国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the San Jose National High School – Daniel C. Mantos Annex in Barangay Daniel C. Mantos, Municipality of Mahayag, Province of Zamboanga Del Sur From the San Jose National High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Daniel C. Mantos National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Daniel C. Mantos của Trường Trung học San Jose Quốc gia tại Barangay Daniel C. Mantos, Đô thị Mahayag, Tỉnh Zamboanga Del Sur khỏi Trường Trung học San Jose Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Daniel C. Mantos Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Daniel C. Mantos ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา San Jose แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Daniel C. Mantos เทศบาล Mahayag จังหวัด Zamboanga Del Sur ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา San Jose แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Daniel C. Mantos แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Daniel C. Mantos, Sekolah Menengah San Jose Nasional di Barangay Daniel C. Mantos, Kotamadya Mahayag, Provinsi Zamboanga Del Sur dari Sekolah Menengah San Jose Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Daniel C. Mantos Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Daniel C. Mantos, Sekolah Menengah San Jose Kebangsaan di Barangay Daniel C. Mantos Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: The San Jose National High School – Daniel C. Mantos Annex in Barangay Daniel C. Mantos, Municipality of Mahayag, Province of Zamboanga del Sur is hereby separated from the San Jose National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Daniel C. Mantos National High School.
All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the San Jose National High School – Daniel C. Mantos Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Daniel C. Mantos National High School.

The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Daniel C. Mantos National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriation of the San Jose National High School – Daniel C. Mantos Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
The Secretary of Education shall issue the rules and regulations necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
